description: Connects a custom domain to an ifova online store: apex A record(s) to the ifova edge, www CNAME to the ifova edge host, and an ownership-verification TXT record at a fixed host.
variableDescription: ip1: first IPv4 address of the ifova edge (group apex-a1). ip2: second IPv4 address of the ifova edge (group apex-a2; the group is omitted when only one address is in use). connectLabel: label under ifova.com that the www CNAME points to, e.g. connect (group www). token: opaque ownership-verification token issued by ifova for this store and domain (group ownership; omitted once the domain is verified).
